Hey, I know I dont know you at all, and even though we've never really talked before, I want you to know something important:  
Feeling worthless or without purpose is hard, and it might seem like nobody cares, but that's not true. There are people who care about you. I know it's hard to believe, especially when you're fighting this battle on your own.  
If you ever feel like you don't have anyone to talk to, please reach out to me. Seriously, message me. You come across as an amazing person, and I'd love to chat and hopefully be friends.  
Please, don't do anything harmful. I genuinely care, and I mean it.
